headline: GIFT Nifty signals rebound as Indian markets reopen; US tariff reports and SpiceJet fleet crisis weigh on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty indicates a strong rebound after the Sensex dropped over 1,400 points earlier this week
Reports suggest the US is planning tariff hikes on India and 15 other countries
Heavy selling in banking and metal sectors recently pressured domestic indices
Investors are assessing global cues including mixed US market performance and tech sector developments
whatHappening: SpiceJet has significantly reduced operations to 20 flights per day as its fleet size dropped to six
Indian markets remained closed on Tuesday, November 24, in observance of Guru Nanak Jayanti
Analysts have identified the 26,000 mark as a significant resistance level for the Nifty 50
Microsoft declared a 'Code Red' following a 24-hour outage of Outlook and Teams services
summary: Indian markets are expected to open higher today as GIFT Nifty signals a rebound following a sharp sell-off earlier in the week. Investors are tracking news of potential US tariffs and a crisis at SpiceJet, which has seen its fleet shrink to just six aircraft. Resistance for the Nifty is seen at 26,000, with banking and metal stocks remaining in focus after recent volatility.
